use: The facts of the pinned OpenHands ACP registry that the S-03.3 qualification create relies on, read as data from the locked wheels (nothing run). Line numbers are of those wheels' files. acp_qualification.py pins this file by sha256 and checks the create fixture against it.

env_conflicts.source: openhands/sdk/settings/acp_providers.py:404-409; applied by ACPAgent._strip_conflicting_env, openhands/sdk/agent/acp_agent.py:2811-2834, only when the dominant variable is present

explicit_command_verbatim.value: a non-empty acp_command is used verbatim; an empty one takes the registry's npx command, rewritten to binary_name only when shutil.which finds it

secret_kinds.source: openhands/sdk/secret/secrets.py:93 (StaticSecret), 113-130 (LookupSecret: httpx.get of the url it names, line 128)

blank_secret_is_none.value: an empty, whitespace-only or redacted StaticSecret value validates to None

registry_exports_non_empty_only.value: get_all_secrets_as_env_vars exports a secret only when its value is non-empty

acp_subprocess_environment.value: default_environment(), then os.environ of the inner server, then the whole secret registry, then the data dir, file secrets, CLAUDECODE removed and env_conflicts; never sanitized_env

sanitized_env_strips.source: openhands/sdk/utils/command.py:17-30, 62-68 (the native terminal's environment, not the ACP subprocess's)

container_environment.source: openhands/agent_server/docker_runtime/registry.py:615-665 (the Docker runtime passes both into the conversation container)
